name: Pacehouse
summary: A training and club app for a running club: route player, week plan, podium and fees
about: A complete training and club app for runners in race black and electric lime, filled with a Lahore running club, 36 members and three months of runs. Press play on a route and a runner travels the drawn city map while the height chart follows; draw your own route by clicking the map. Coaches plan the week by dragging sessions, log runs, collect fees in rupees and run a podium leaderboard. Good for a running club, a coach or a training app, in dark and light.
how: On Club, watch the race countdown tick, switch the weekly distance chart by group and send kudos in the feed
In Routes, press Play: the runner moves along the map with live distance, time and height, and a cursor runs along the profile
Choose Draw a route, click the map to drop points, undo or save it with a name
In Training, drag sessions between days (or use Move to…); the planned-load chart updates
Log, edit or delete runs with time checks and live pace; click a run for its map and per-km splits
Mark fees paid, add members with mobile checks, join events and switch the leaderboard range for the podium
Switch kilometres and miles in Settings and everything converts
